text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer thought to herself: Racing 
shouldn't just be about bearing the 
crushing weight of the Twinkle Series. 
Wouldn't it be okay to focus more on 
having fun?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, she threw herself back into 
freestyle races where she could run 
without restraint. Here, there were 
neither ties nor responsibilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Freestyle racing, however, felt 
unfulfilling to Mejiro Palmer as she was 
now. It was hot and fun, but it lacked 
real pressure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—I want to return to the same stage as 
Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen. And I want 
to stand triumphant there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having realized where she truly belonged, 
Mejiro Palmer returned once more to the 
Twinkle Series.
